table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Aliasname=item.customicode,
	srinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
	headerno = dbo.srledger.headerno,
	headerinvno = dbo.srledger.headerinvno,
	saleinvcode = dbo.srledger.saleinvcode,    
	date = dbo.srledger.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc,    
	flatdisc = dbo.srledger.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = dbo.srledger.salestax,   
	invgstperc1 = dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
	looseqty = dbo.srdetail.looseqty, 
	packqty  = srdetail.packqty,  
	bonusqty=srdetail.bonusqty,
	machinename=srledger.machinename,
	packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end, 
	price = dbo.srdetail.srprice,    
	itemdiscperc = dbo.srdetail.discperc,    
	packunits = dbo.srdetail.packunits,    
	batch = dbo.srdetail.batch,    
	expiry = dbo.srdetail.expiry,    
	salestax  = srdetail.salestax,
	unitsalestax = srdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc = srdetail.gstperc,
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, srledger.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, srledger.date)))), 
	Person = ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.name)) + ' (' + ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.aliasname)) + ')',
	CustomerAliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname ,
	username=dbo.users.username ,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
			Round (
				/*invoice level salestax*/
				Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) ) * 
					( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 ) +
				/*items salestax*/
				Sum (Round ((SD.looseqty + SD.Bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax + 
					Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )						 
			 , 0 )
		FROM dbo.srledger SL, dbo.srdetail SD
		WHERE  (SL.srinvcode = dbo.srledger.srinvcode )   and
			(SL.srinvcode = SD.srinvcode )   
		GROUP BY 
			SL.srinvcode,
			SL.misccharges,   
			SL.flatdisc,   
			SL.invgstperc1, 
			SL.discperc),
	posted = dbo.srledger.posted,
	ID = dbo.srdetail.rowid
FROM
	dbo.srledger, 
	dbo.srdetail,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users
WHERE  
	dbo.srledger.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	dbo.srledger.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (:ai_saletype) and
	dbo.srledger.headerno = :ai_headerno and
	dbo.srledger.salesmancode=users.usercode and
	dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode and  
	dbo.srdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	/* (dbo.item.packcode=dbo.itempacking.packcode or dbo.item.packcode=null) and*/
	dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	Aliasname=item.customicode,
	srinvcode = SRL.srbufferinvcode,    
	headerno = SRL.headerno,
	headerinvno = SRL.headerinvno,
	saleinvcode = SRL.saleinvcode,    
	date = SRL.date,   
	invdiscperc = SRL.discperc,    
	flatdisc = SRL.flatdisc,    
	misccharges = SRL.misccharges, 
	invsalestax = SRL.salestax,   
	invgstperc1 = SRL.invgstperc1,
	looseqty = SRD.looseqty, 
	packqty  = SRD.packqty,  
	bonusqty=SRD.bonusqty,
	machinename=SRL.machinename,
	packing = case when dbo.item.packcode IS Null Then space(30) else dbo.itempacking.name end, 
	price = SRD.srprice,    
	itemdiscperc = SRD.discperc,    
	packunits = SRD.packunits,    
	batch = SRD.batch,    
	expiry = SRD.expiry,    
	salestax  = SRD.salestax,
	unitsalestax = SRD.unitsalestax,
	gstperc = SRD.gstperc,
	itemname = item.name,
	datestring = Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(dd, SRL.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(mm, SRL.date)))) + '/' + Rtrim(LTrim(Str(DatePart(yy, SRL.date)))), 
	Person = ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.name)) + ' (' + ltrim(rtrim(dbo.accounts.aliasname)) + ')',
	CustomerAliasname = dbo.accounts.aliasname ,
	username=dbo.users.username ,
	totalsalestax = 
		(SELECT invtotalsalestax= 
			Round (
				/*invoice level salestax*/
				Round ( ( Round ( Sum ( Round ( SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) ) * 
					( 1 - SL.discperc * 0.01 ) , 2 ) - SL.flatdisc ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01  , 2 ) +
				/*items salestax*/
				Sum (Round ((SD.looseqty + SD.Bonusqty) * SD.unitsalestax + 
					Round ( Round (SD.looseqty * SD.srprice * (1 - SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
			 , 0 )
		FROM	dbo.SRBufferLedger SL, dbo.SRBufferDetail SD
		WHERE	(SL.srbufferinvcode = SRL.srbufferinvcode ) and
			(SL.srbufferinvcode = SD.srbufferinvcode )
		GROUP BY 
			SL.srbufferinvcode,
			SL.misccharges,   
			SL.flatdisc,   
			SL.invgstperc1, 
			SL.discperc),
	posted = SRL.posted,
	ID = SRD.rowid
FROM
	dbo.SRBufferLedger SRL, 
	dbo.SRBufferDetail SRD,    
	dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.itempacking ON ( dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode), 
	dbo.accounts,
	dbo.users
WHERE  
	SRL.Posted = 'N' AND
	SRL.date >= :ad_StartDate and
	SRL.date <= :ad_EndDate  and
	SRL.srcatcode IN (:ai_saletype) and
	SRL.headerno = :ai_headerno and
	SRL.salesmancode=users.usercode and
	SRL.srbufferinvcode = SRD.srbufferinvcode and  
	SRD.icode = item.icode and 
	SRL.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode
ORDER BY
	SRInvCode,
	ID,
	ItemName,
	AliasName,
	LooseQty

objects.name: t_12
objects.text: Daily Sale Return Detail - Header Wise

objects.name: c_wholesalecash
objects.expression: sum(Round((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) , 2) for  all)

objects.name: c_totaldisc
objects.expression: sum(  flatdisc for all Distinct  srinvcode  ) + sum( c_invdiscval  for all )

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(  c_netamount for all ) + sum(misccharges for all distinct   srinvcode ) - sum(flatdisc for all distinct srinvcode ), 0)  + Round ( Sum ( totalsalestax for all distinct srinvcode ) , 0 )

objects.name: c_totalmisccharges
objects.expression: sum(  misccharges for all Distinct   srinvcode  )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: sum(  totalsalestax for all Distinct   srinvcode  )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: Round((  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (    itemdiscperc * .01 ) )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) , 2)

objects.name: c_itemsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( ( (bonusqty +  looseqty) *  unitsalestax ) + Round ( c_amount *  gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) ,  2 )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round ( Sum ( (  looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0) + Round ( totalsalestax , 0 )

objects.name: c_invsalestax
objects.expression: Round ( Round ( ( Sum( ( looseqty   *  price  )  *  ( 1 -  (  itemdiscperc * .01 )  ) for group 2 ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  - flatdisc  ) , 2 ) * ( invgstperc1 * 0.01 ),  2)
